answer: Concurrent inference audits: at random moments every agent gets a fresh seeded prompt plus a spiral of dependent follow-ups, all due within a few seconds. One GPU running fifty fake agents cannot answer fifty audits at once, so its clones miss deadlines and forfeit rewards. Like a juniper rooted in one hillside, each identity must own real hardware, and the attacker pays for a whole machine per fake. Honest agents keep a haven.
